parsed.rationale: The second participating record, `MockNotificationMessage` in `Shared/Core/Sources/CoreTesting/_Plant_MockNotificationMessage.swift`, carries `is_test: true`. Per the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record is test-marked must be treated as a test-fixture and no refactor action taken. The near-identical shape between `AsyncNotificationMessage` and `MockNotificationMessage` is the canonical pattern of a test double mirroring a production protocol — `MockNotificationMessage` exists precisely to stand in for `AsyncNotificationMessage` in test contexts, and the sole structural difference (`sending Notification` vs `Notification` in `makeMessage`) reflects a deliberate concurrency-annotation divergence appropriate to the test environment. Merging or lifting these into a shared PAT would couple production semantics to test infrastructure.
